title: CAMERA:
content:
CAMERA:
DV 16mm handheld camcorder POV. CHASE holds the camera or props it on the treadmill/bike console. Natural shake, soft focus, delayed focus pulls, clumsy zooms, imperfect framing. Camcorder never visible.

LOOK:
Soft vintage tape quality, slight blur, tape noise, bloomed gym lights, flickering auto-exposure, muted contrast.

STYLE:
High-energy cardio vlog. Upbeat, breathless, camera bouncing with movement, building to a sweaty, satisfying finish.

CHARACTER:
CHASE — Korean woman in her 20s. High ponytail, glowing skin with increasing sweat, slim athletic build. Modest long-sleeve athletic top, loose joggers/leggings, sneakers.

SETTING:
Evening gym cardio area with treadmill/bike, mirrors, cardio machines, phone playing music, soft lighting.

SCENES:
1. Starts treadmill. "Okay, cardio time!"
2. Running. "This song's so good."
3. Wipes sweat. "Five minutes in and I already regret this."
4. Close-up of feet, sweat, treadmill.
5. Faster sprint. "Almost... done..."
6. Slows down, towel. "I survived."
7. Sweaty grin. "That actually felt really good."
8. Steps off, thumbs up. "Cardio done—see you guys."

es.content:
CÁMARA:
POV de una videocámara handheld DV de 16 mm. CHASE sostiene la cámara o la apoya sobre la consola de la cinta/bicicleta. Sacudidas naturales, enfoque suave, cambios de enfoque tardíos, zooms torpes, encuadre imperfecto. La videocámara nunca es visible.

APARIENCIA:
Calidad suave de cinta vintage, ligero desenfoque, ruido de cinta, luces del gimnasio con bloom, autoexposición parpadeante, contraste apagado.

ESTILO:
Vlog de cardio de alta energía. Animado, entrecortado, la cámara rebota con el movimiento, construyendo hacia un final sudoroso y satisfactorio.

PERSONAJE:
CHASE — mujer coreana de unos 20 años. Coleta alta, piel luminosa con sudor cada vez más visible, complexión atlética y esbelta. Top deportivo de manga larga y discreto, joggers/leggings holgados, zapatillas.

ESCENARIO:
Zona de cardio de un gimnasio por la tarde-noche con cinta/bicicleta, espejos, máquinas de cardio, teléfono reproduciendo música, iluminación suave.

ESCENAS:
1. Empieza en la cinta. "Okay, cardio time!"
2. Corriendo. "This song's so good."
3. Se seca el sudor. "Five minutes in and I already regret this."
4. Primer plano de los pies, el sudor, la cinta.
5. Sprint más rápido. "Almost... done..."
6. Baja el ritmo, toalla. "I survived."
7. Sonrisa sudorosa. "That actually felt really good."
8. Se baja, pulgar arriba. "Cardio done—see you guys."

fr.content:
CAMÉRA :
POV d’un caméscope DV 16 mm tenu à la main. CHASE tient la caméra ou la pose sur la console du tapis de course/vélo. Tremblements naturels, mise au point douce, transitions de mise au point retardées, zooms maladroits, cadrage imparfait. Le caméscope n’est jamais visible.

LOOK :
Qualité de bande vintage douce, léger flou, bruit de bande, lumières de salle de sport qui débordent, auto-exposition vacillante, contraste atténué.

STYLE :
Vlog cardio à haute énergie. Ton enjoué, essoufflé, caméra qui rebondit avec le mouvement, menant à une fin moite et satisfaisante.

CHARACTER :
CHASE — femme coréenne dans la vingtaine. Queue-de-cheval haute, peau lumineuse avec une transpiration qui augmente, silhouette athlétique et fine. Haut de sport à manches longues modeste, jogging/leggings amples, baskets.

SETTING :
Zone cardio d’une salle de sport en soirée avec tapis de course/vélo, miroirs, machines de cardio, téléphone diffusant de la musique, éclairage doux.

SCENES :
1. Commence le tapis de course. "Okay, cardio time!"
2. Court. "This song's so good."
3. S’essuie la sueur. "Five minutes in and I already regret this."
4. Gros plan sur les pieds, la sueur, le tapis de course.
5. Sprint plus rapide. "Almost... done..."
6. Ralentit, serviette. "I survived."
7. Sourire moite. "That actually felt really good."
8. Descend, pouce levé. "Cardio done—see you guys."

ja.content:
---
CAMERA:
DV 16mmのハンディカムコーダー視点。CHASEがカメラを手に持つか、トレッドミル／バイクのコンソールに立てかけて撮影している。自然な揺れ、ソフトフォーカス、遅れて入るフォーカス送り、不器用なズーム、完璧ではないフレーミング。カムコーダー自体は映らない。

LOOK:
やわらかなヴィンテージテープの質感、わずかなブレ、テープノイズ、にじんだジムの照明、ちらつく自動露出、抑えめのコントラスト。

STYLE:
ハイエナジーなカーディオVlog。明るく息の上がる感じで、カメラも動きに合わせて弾み、汗だくで満足感のあるフィニッシュへと盛り上がっていく。

CHARACTER:
CHASE — 20代の韓国人女性。高いポニーテール、汗が増えていくツヤのある肌、細身でアスレチックな体型。控えめな長袖のアスレチックトップ、ゆったりしたジョガーパンツ／レギンス、スニーカー。

SETTING:
夜のジムのカーディオエリア。トレッドミル／バイク、鏡、カーディオマシン、音楽を流しているスマホ、やわらかな照明。

SCENES:
1. トレッドミルを始める。「よし、カーディオの時間！」
2. 走る。「この曲、めっちゃいい。」
3. 汗を拭く。「始めて5分でもう後悔してる。」
4. 足元、汗、トレッドミルのクローズアップ。
5. さらに速くスプリント。「もう少し……で……」
6. ペースを落として、タオルを手に取る。「生き延びた。」
7. 汗だくの笑顔。「意外と、すごく気持ちよかった。」
8. 降りて、親指を立てる。「カーディオ完了—またね。」
---

ko.content:
CAMERA:
DV 16mm 핸드헬드 캠코더 POV. CHASE가 카메라를 들고 있거나 러닝머신/자전거 콘솔 위에 올려둔다. 자연스러운 흔들림, 소프트 포커스, 지연된 포커스 풀, 서툰 줌, 불완전한 프레이밍. 캠코더는 절대 보이지 않는다.

LOOK:
부드러운 빈티지 테이프 질감, 약간의 블러, 테이프 노이즈, 번진 체육관 조명, 깜빡이는 자동 노출, 절제된 대비.

STYLE:
에너지 넘치는 cardio vlog. 경쾌하고 숨 가쁜 느낌, 움직임에 따라 카메라가 흔들리며, 땀에 젖은 만족스러운 마무리로 이어진다.

CHARACTER:
CHASE — 20대 한국인 여성. 높은 포니테일, 점점 땀이 맺히는 빛나는 피부, 슬림한 운동 체형. 단정한 긴소매 운동 상의, 헐렁한 조거 팬츠/레깅스, 스니커즈.

SETTING:
저녁의 체육관 cardio 구역. 러닝머신/자전거, 거울, cardio 기구들, 음악을 재생하는 휴대폰, 부드러운 조명.

SCENES:
1. 러닝머신을 시작한다. "Okay, cardio time!"
2. 달린다. "This song's so good."
3. 땀을 닦는다. "Five minutes in and I already regret this."
4. 발, 땀, 러닝머신 클로즈업.
5. 더 빠르게 전력 질주한다. "Almost... done..."
6. 속도를 늦추고 수건을 든다. "I survived."
7. 땀에 젖은 미소. "That actually felt really good."
8. 내려서 엄지를 치켜든다. "Cardio done—see you guys."

pt.content:
CÂMERA:
POV de uma filmadora DV 16mm na mão. CHASE segura a câmera ou a apoia no painel da esteira/bicicleta. Tremor natural, foco suave, mudanças de foco atrasadas, zooms desajeitados, enquadramento imperfeito. A filmadora nunca aparece.

VISUAL:
Qualidade suave de fita vintage, leve desfoque, ruído de fita, luzes da academia com bloom, autoexposição oscilando, contraste suave.

ESTILO:
Vlog de cardio de alta energia. Animado, ofegante, câmera quicando com o movimento, culminando em um final suado e satisfatório.

PERSONAGEM:
CHASE — mulher coreana na casa dos 20 anos. Rabo de cavalo alto, pele luminosa com suor aumentando, corpo atlético e esguio. Top esportivo de manga longa discreto, joggers/leggings folgados, tênis.

AMBIENTE:
Área de cardio de uma academia à noite, com esteira/bicicleta, espelhos, aparelhos de cardio, celular tocando música, iluminação suave.

CENAS:
1. Começa na esteira. "Okay, cardio time!"
2. Correndo. "This song's so good."
3. Enxuga o suor. "Five minutes in and I already regret this."
4. Close-up dos pés, suor, esteira.
5. Sprint mais rápido. "Almost... done..."
6. Diminui o ritmo, toalha. "I survived."
7. Sorriso suado. "That actually felt really good."
8. Sai da esteira, joinha. "Cardio done—see you guys."

zh.content:
CAMERA:
DV 16mm 手持摄像机 POV。CHASE 手持相机，或将其架在跑步机/动感单车控制台上。自然抖动、轻微失焦、延迟拉焦、笨拙变焦、构图不完美。摄像机始终不可见。

LOOK:
柔和的复古磁带质感，轻微模糊，磁带噪点，健身房灯光泛光，自动曝光闪烁，低饱和对比度。

STYLE:
高能量有氧 vlog。轻快、气喘吁吁，镜头随着动作晃动，逐步推进到一个满身汗却令人满足的收尾。

CHARACTER:
CHASE — 20 多岁的韩国女性。高马尾，随着出汗逐渐发亮的皮肤，纤细的运动体型。朴素的长袖运动上衣，宽松慢跑裤/紧身裤，运动鞋。

SETTING:
傍晚的健身房有氧区，配有跑步机/动感单车、镜子、有氧器械、播放音乐的手机、柔和灯光。

SCENES:
1. 开始跑步机。 "Okay, cardio time!"
2. 跑步中。 "This song's so good."
3. 擦汗。 "Five minutes in and I already regret this."
4. 脚部、汗水、跑步机的特写。
5. 更快冲刺。 "Almost... done..."
6. 放慢速度，拿毛巾。 "I survived."
7. 满脸汗却咧嘴笑。 "That actually felt really good."
8. 走下器械，竖起大拇指。 "Cardio done—see you guys."
